items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Delivery timing depends on your destination and is shown at checkout. Once your order ships, tracking details are sent to the email used for your purchase.

items.question: Where is my order?
items.answer: Use the Track Your Order form on this page with your order number and checkout email. You can also use the tracking link from your dispatch email.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Yes. Refunds are handled according to our Return & Refund Policy. Contact support with your order number if you need help starting a request.

items.question: How can I change my shipping address?
items.answer: Contact support as soon as possible with your order number and the correct address. Address changes cannot always be guaranteed after fulfillment begins.

items.question: Are taxes included?
items.answer: Any applicable taxes, duties, or delivery charges are shown as clearly as possible during checkout and may vary by destination.

items.question: Do products come with warranty?
items.answer: Warranty availability depends on the product. Check the product information or contact support with the product name for guidance.

items.question: How can I contact support?
items.answer: Use the contact form on this page or email support@weluxo.com. Please include your order number when your question is about an existing purchase.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Available payment methods are displayed securely during checkout. Payment details are processed through trusted payment providers.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: Enter your order number and checkout email in the tracking form, or use the tracking link sent after your order is dispatched.

items.question: How do I start a return?
items.answer: Review the Return & Refund Policy, then contact support with your order number and the reason for your request. We will explain the next steps.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Choose a product, review its details, add it to your cart, and follow the secure checkout steps to complete your purchase.

items.question: Can I change my order?
items.answer: Contact support as soon as possible with your order number and requested change. Changes cannot always be guaranteed after fulfillment begins.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: Contact support immediately if you need to cancel. Cancellation cannot always be guaranteed after an order has entered fulfillment or shipped.

items.question: I did not receive my confirmation email
items.answer: Check your spam or promotions folder first. If you still cannot find the confirmation, contact support with the email and details used at checkout.

items.question: Where does Weluxo ship?
items.answer: Weluxo ships to customers in many destinations worldwide. Availability and delivery charges are confirmed at checkout for your address.

items.question: How can I track my package?
items.answer: Use the tracking link in your dispatch email or enter your order number and checkout email in the Track Your Order form.

items.question: Why is my tracking number not updating?
items.answer: Tracking can take time to update after a carrier receives a package. If there has been no movement for an unusual period, contact support for help.

items.question: Accepted payment methods
items.answer: The payment methods available for your destination are displayed securely during checkout.

items.question: Payment failed
items.answer: Confirm your payment details and try again, or use another available payment method. Contact your payment provider or Weluxo support if the issue continues.

items.question: Currency questions
items.answer: Prices and checkout currency can vary by region. The final amount and currency are shown before you complete payment.

items.question: Refund process
items.answer: Once a return or refund is approved, the refund is sent through the original payment method. Processing time can vary by payment provider.

items.question: Weluxo return policy
items.answer: Returns are handled according to our Return & Refund Policy. Contact support with your order number if you need help understanding eligibility.

items.question: How to request a return
items.answer: Contact support with your order number, the item you want to return, and the reason for the request. We will guide you through the next steps.

items.question: Refund timeline
items.answer: After approval, refund timing depends on the original payment provider. Weluxo support can confirm the status of a specific request.

items.question: Product instructions
items.answer: Start with the product guide included with your order. Contact support if you need a digital guide or help using a product.

items.question: Product compatibility
items.answer: Review the product specifications and compatibility details on the product page. Contact support before ordering if you need help checking a setup.

items.question: Warranty information
items.answer: Warranty availability depends on the product. Check the product information or contact support with the product name for guidance.

items.question: Product troubleshooting
items.answer: Check the product instructions and basic setup requirements first. If the issue continues, contact support with the product and order details.

items.question: Create an account
items.answer: Select Account and follow the sign-up steps using your email address. An account helps you review orders and manage your details.

items.question: Reset password
items.answer: Use the password reset option on the sign-in page and follow the instructions sent to your account email.

items.question: Update account information
items.answer: Sign in to your account, open your profile settings, and update the information you need to change.
